[To [Anne Yonge](/person/1582)]At the Hall[^1] is a beautiful picture of [King Charles](/person/1768) the martyr, a full-length, and with the beautiful forehead we always see him drawn with.


[^1]: West Dean, near Chichester, Sussex, where they were staying with CMY’s godmother [Caroline Vernon Harcourt](/person/1422), sister of its owner, Lord Selsey.
